dek: The few capital decisions worth understanding today—reported with scarcity, evidence, and a point of view.

deal_tape.title: ‘You Can’t Fool the Bond,’ Says BofA’s Cabana on the Fed
deal_tape.one_line: Mark Cabana, head of US rates strategy at BofA Global Research, says the Federal Reserve now has a credibility issue as he discusses the bond market’s reaction to last week’s interest rate decision from the Fed. (Source: Bloomberg)

deal_tape.title: Dollar Drops Further as Yen Rebound Extends Fed-Driven Slide
deal_tape.one_line: The dollar extended its slide on Monday as a joint US-Japan intervention to support the yen added to losses triggered by last week’s Federal Reserve meeting.
